rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something has gone missing or been misplaced.

example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 haai4 m4 gin3 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something is not present where it should be.

example.english: One person is missing; Ming isn't here.
example.traditional: 少咗一個人，阿明唔喺度。
example.jyutping: siu2 zo2 jat1 go3 jan4 aa3 ming4 m4 hai2 dou6

rows.note: Use this for information or an item that has been omitted rather than physically misplaced.

example.english: Your name is missing from my form.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fan6 biu2 lau6 zo2 nei5 go3 meng2
